# rump primitive microbenchmarks

Fresh random operands per pilot-bench trial; preset `normal`,
session cap 30s per op. Mean is the average over random inputs;
the ns/op order statistics are the extrema of each variable-time
primitive, from the readings pilot-bench gathered (`max/min` = 1.0 means
data-independent). A `~` on the mean flags a heavy-tailed op that hit
the session cap without the mean CI converging (its extrema are the
meaningful result); tail resolution tracks the sample size.
